title: Sorrento, Worn Over Time: Ezeta Mark 80 Years With a Living Legacy Jersey
excerpt: Ezeta and Sorrento Calcio mark a milestone moment with a jersey that does far more than look back. Celebrating 80 years of the club, the new anniversary shirt lands as a thoughtful fusion of histor...
paragraphs: Ezeta and Sorrento Calcio mark a milestone moment with a jersey that does far more than look back. Celebrating 80 years of the club, the new anniversary shirt lands as a thoughtful fusion of history, place and people.

Ezeta and Sorrento Calcio mark a milestone moment with a jersey that does far more than look back. Celebrating 80 years of the club, the new anniversary shirt lands as a thoughtful fusion of history, place and people — brought to life through a beautifully observed campaign titled “Sorrento, worn over time.”

At the heart of the design of the Sorrento 80th anniversary jersey sits a tribute to one of the club’s most defining chapters. The jersey takes its cues from the 1970/71 away kit — the season that saw Sorrento secure historic promotion to Serie B. Back then, it was a clean white base cut through by a bold red-and-black diagonal sash. A simple, confident statement that has lived long in the club’s collective memory.

Ezeta’s reinterpretation honours that legacy without leaning on nostalgia alone. The diagonal sash returns, but this time it’s subtly reshaped through the diamond pattern taken from the Sorrento crest — an iconic symbol tied as much to the city as the club itself. It’s a clever piece of design thinking: history filtered through identity, rather than copied outright.

title: Ezeta Sorrento 25-26 80th Anniversary Kit Released
excerpt: Sorrento FC and their kit supplier Ezeta have released their 80th Anniversary jersey, paying tribute to the club’s iconic 1970-71 away kit, the season that marked their historic promotion to Serie B.
paragraphs: Sorrento FC and their kit supplier Ezeta have released their 80th Anniversary jersey, paying tribute to the club’s iconic 1970-71 away kit, the season that marked their historic promotion to Serie B.
For the launch campaign, Ezeta imagines the 80th anniversary kit to be worn in the past, with the help of artificial intelligence.

The Ezeta Sorrento Calcio 25-26 80th anniversary jersey reinterpretes the original sash of the 1970-71 shirt for today, with the sash now formed by the diamond pattern of the Sorrento crest, a symbol closely tied to the city.
The Sorrento 25-26 80 years anniversary kit also features subtle tone-on-tone wooden inlays inspired by Sorrento’s artisan tradition, reinforcing the connection to local heritage.

Finishing touches of the Sorrento 25-26 80th anniversary kit include the club’s founding date on the back of the collar and a commemorative crest where the number 80 incorporates the five diamonds, giving the shirt a distinct collector-focused feel.

title: Sorrento, presentata la maglia dell’80° anniversario
excerpt: Il Sorrento fa un tuffo nel passato con un occhio al futuro. Tramite i propri canali ufficiali, viene presentata la nuova maglia in occasione dell’80° anniversario del club. Di seguito il comunicat...
paragraphs: Il Sorrento fa un tuffo nel passato con un occhio al futuro. Tramite i propri canali ufficiali, viene presentata la nuova maglia in occasione dell’80° anniversario del club. Di seguito il comunicato ufficiale.

“ La maglia del Sorrento per l’80° anniversario è un omaggio alla maglia da trasferta del 1970/71, anno della storica promozione in Serie B. Il video e gli scatti, realizzati con l’intelligenza artificiale, rievocano la storia e le emozioni rossonere attraverso un’estetica heritage”.

“All’epoca la divisa era bianca, caratterizzata dalla tipica fascia diagonale rossonera. Oggi, nella nostra reinterpretazione, la fascia prende forma dai rombi del logo del Sorrento, simbolo iconico della città”.

“Gli intarsi lignei tono su tono, ispirati alla tradizione sorrentina, impreziosiscono la maglia rafforzandone il legame con il territorio. Dettagli come la data di fondazione sul retro del colletto e lo stemma celebrativo, dove il numero 80 avvolge i 5 rombi, donano alla maglia un carattere esclusivo che la rende un must-have da collezione”.

title: Ezeta Drop Latina Calcio 25/26 Kits With Venetian Spirit
excerpt: Ezeta have unveiled Latina Calcio’s home, away and third shirts for the 2025/26 season,and with them comes – as you’d expect from the brand – a story stitched in heritage, design, and a deep connec...
paragraphs: Ezeta have unveiled Latina Calcio’s home, away and third shirts for the 2025/26 season, and with them comes – as you'd expect from the brand – a story stitched in heritage.

Rooted in history and carrying forward a cultural legacy, the Latina Calcio 25/26 kit collection from Ezeta pays tribute to the Flag of Saint Mark – a symbol that once united the settlers who laid the foundations of Littoria, now the modern city of Latina. The home shirt is where that legacy takes its boldest form. Gone are the traditional stripes; in their place, the Winged Lion of Saint Mark stands proudly across the body of the jersey. It’s less a kit, more a flag worn on the pitch – a declaration of identity. Completing the design, the collar and cuffs carry the inscription “Pax Tibi Marce, Evangelista Meus,” the timeless words that honour the patron saint of the city. For the away shirt , Ezeta move into more intricate territory. Taking inspiration from oriental-inspired floral motifs found on one of the historic Flags of Saint Mark, the design embodies the cultural fusion and artistic elegance of Venice. The result is a kit that feels refined yet expressive, a canvas of pattern and heritage. Then there’s the third kit – a striking piece drenched in deep crimson red and trimmed with gold. Its look references the golden flames of the Venetian flag, a motif synonymous with strength and justice. Bold in colour and powerful in symbolism, it’s a kit designed to stand out both on and off the pitch.

With all three kits, Ezeta have done more than simply dress Latina Calcio for the new season. They’ve turned the club’s shirts into living tributes – carrying the echoes of Venice, the symbolism of Saint Mark, and the pride of a city whose story continues to evolve.

title: Outstanding Ezeta Latina 25-26 Home, Away & Third Kits Released
excerpt: Ezeta has officially unveiled Latina Calcio’s 2025-26 kits, a collection deeply rooted in the city’s cultural identity and inspired by its lasting ties to Venetian heritage — a tribute to art, pas...
paragraphs: Ezeta has officially unveiled Latina Calcio’s 2025-26 kits, a collection deeply rooted in the city’s cultural history and its ties to Venetian heritage.

Latina's new 25-26 home, away and third uniforms pay homage to the Flag of Saint Mark, a unifying symbol for the communities that settled in the area during the reclamation of the Pontine Marshes, when many Venetian migrants brought their traditions, including the veneration of Saint Mark, to what was then called Littoria. The Ezeta Latina 2025-2026 jersey takes the concept of a “Flag Jersey” literally, replacing the club’s usual stripes with a striking full-width depiction of the Winged Lion of Saint Mark. The outstanding design of the Ezeta Latina 2025-2026 home shirt is complemented by a collar and sleeve trim carrying the inscription “Pax Tibi Marce, Evangelista Meus” , reinforcing the tribute to the city’s historical roots. The Ezeta Latina 25-26 away jersey draws from the oriental-inspired floral motifs found in historic Venetian flags, reflecting both artistic elegance and the blending of cultures that defined Venice at its height. For the Latina 25-26 third kit , Ezeta has opted for refined crimson red and gold, echoing the famous golden flames of the Saint Mark banner.

title: How Sorrento Calcio’s New Jerseys Brought Artistry to Serie C
excerpt: When Sorrento Calcio unveiled their 25/26 jerseys, they offered more than a new look they told a story of craftsmanship, culture, and belonging. In doing so, they captured the attention of the foot...
paragraphs: When Sorrento Calcio unveiled their 2025/26 jerseys, they offered more than a new look – they told a story of craftsmanship, culture, and belonging. In doing so, they captured the attention of the football world – no small feat for a Serie C side rarely found in the spotlight.

The new home shirt reimagines Sorrento’s iconic red and black stripes through the refined lens of the region’s historic artisans. The design is inspired by the decorative craft of wood inlay for which the city is renowned, each line and pattern of the shirt mirroring the delicate precision of master craftsmen. At its heart, the five diamonds – taken from the club crest and the city’s coat of arms – reverberate with renewed reverence, their symbolism enriched by this tribute to centuries-old heritage. In contrast, the away kit draws from the sun-drenched citrus groves that cascade endlessly across hillsides above the Bay of Naples, infusing the design with the vibrant hues of ripened citrus. The elegant white base is no blank canvas, but a radiant echo of Mediterranean light, its soft embellishments evoking the artistry of hand-painted stone tables that grace local courtyards.

And the creative vision didn’t stop there. The launch campaign elevated the kits into the realm of poetry, with a visual homage to Torquato Tasso, the 16th century poet and famed son of the city. Smouldering camera work imbued the collection with the romantic and chivalric themes that define Tasso’s epic verse.

Behind it all is Ezeta, a brand for whom the template shirt is taboo. Since 2020, Ezeta have been crafting garments that are not just shirts but identities steeped in the history, culture, and mythical soul of the cities they represent. As Sorrento Calcio enters its third consecutive season in Serie C, the club may remain modest in stature, but in these jerseys, it wears the weight of its legacy with elegance – and ambition.

title: Genoa stile inglese, spettacolo Sorrento e Venezia rinascimentale
excerpt: Tempo di nuova stagione, acquisti, trattative ma anche maglie. Il simbolo più iconico del calcio, i kit da gioco, spesso sono poi cimeli che nel corso degli anni assumono valori storici.
paragraphs: Tempo di nuova stagione, acquisti, trattative ma anche maglie. Il simbolo più iconico del calcio, i kit da gioco, spesso sono poi cimeli che nel corso degli anni assumono valori storici. Ecco, di seguito, le maglie che vi siete persi della nuova stagione.

Il Sorrento ha svelato le loro uniformi ufficiali della prossima stagione, progettate per la prima volta da Ezeta, in un lancio che fonde il calcio con l’alta arte, il patrimonio regionale e l’eredità letteraria. La prima rivela un mosaico di tessere in legno in miniatura, formando una maglia che ricorda un’opera d’arte artigianale più di un kit da calcio standard, il riferimento è alla terra di Nobili Cavalieri. La seconda è un vivido omaggio alla bellezza naturale e decorativa della Costiera Amalfitana. Il design evoca l’aspetto di tavoli in pietra dipinti a mano, spesso adornati con limoni, agrumi e motivi floreali che si trovano in tutta la regione.

title: Quand Ezeta dévoile encore une masterclass pour les maillots d’un club de Serie C
excerpt: Comme chaque année, la marque Ezeta fait parler d'elle grâce au design ultra puissant de ses maillots et aux shooting photo dotés d'un univers bien particulier. Cette fois-ci, c'est le club de Sor...
paragraphs: Comme chaque année, la marque Ezeta fait parler d'elle grâce au design ultra puissant de ses maillots et aux shooting photo dotés d'un univers bien particulier. Cette fois-ci, c'est le club de Sorrento Calcio, une équipe de Serie C qui est à l'honneur.

Bien loin de l’attrait des grands championnats européens, la Serie C italienne pourrait vite devenir une compétition qu’il faut suivre pour découvrir des pépites. Après avoir découvert il y a quelques semaines l’incroyable design du ballon de la Serie C imaginé par Kipsta, c’est vers le club de Sorrento Calcio 1945 qu’il faut se tourner. Ne cherchez pas, avant aujourd’hui vous n’aviez probablement jamais entendu parler de ce club italien qui a terminé 14ᵉ la saison passée. Pourtant, s’il est sur le devant de la scène pour 2025-2026, c’est à cause, ou plutôt grâce, à son maillot. Imaginées par la marque Ezeta , qui est déjà bien connue de nos colonnes, les deux nouvelles tenues et le shooting de présentation sont tout simplement exceptionnels. Bien loin de l’univers feutré de nombreux clubs et équipementiers, Sorrento Calcio 1945 et Ezeta ont voulu explorer des territoires nouveaux. En effet, la séance photo rend hommage à l’esprit d’héroïsme chevaleresque célébré dans les œuvres de Torquato Tasso, un illustre poète originaire de Sorrente. Au menu : un mélange de chevalerie et de pose moderne.

title: Ezeta Sorrento 25-26 Home & Away Kits Released - A Cultural Tribute
excerpt: Italian side Sorrento Calcio 1945 has unveiled their official 2025-26 Sorrento's 2025-2026 home and away uniforms, designed for the first time by Ezeta, in a launch that blends football with high a...
paragraphs: Italian side Sorrento Calcio 1945 has unveiled their official 2025-26 Sorrento's 2025-2026 home and away uniforms, designed for the first time by Ezeta, in a launch that blends football with high art, regional heritage, and literary legacy.

The release campaign of the Sorrento Calcio 2025-26 home and away strips pays homage to the spirit of chivalric heroism celebrated in the works of Torquato Tasso – the iconic Renaissance poet born in Sorrento – and draws heavily on the cultural depth and visual identity of the Sorrentine Peninsula. The Ezeta Sorrento 2025-2026 jersey is inspired by the ancient art of Sorrentine wood inlay, a craft deeply rooted in the city’s artisanal tradition. The jersey's pattern replicates the ornamental detail of a finely crafted early 20th-century writing desk housed at the Correale Museum of Sorrento. Red and black stripes, traditional to the club, are intricately combined with five historic diamond emblems, which are long-standing symbols of the city. Up close, the design of the Ezeta Sorrento Calcio 25-26 home football shirt reveals a mosaic of miniature wooden tesserae, forming a jersey that resembles a handcrafted work of art more than a standard football kit.
